name: ghost-fields
description: GHOST FIELD ratchet. Counts `(x as any).prop` reads where `prop` is not on x's pre-cast type — a read that is `undefined` on every row, forever, with tsc explicitly told not to look. Three live defects of this shape were found by hand on 2026-08-21/23, each in a different file and none catchable by any other gate in this repo: auditOrgUsury judged EVERY note in EVERY organization against Texas usury law via `(note as any).propertyState || "TX"`; GET /api/seller-motivation/:leadId synthesized nine of eleven signals from non-existent columns and so returned at most two distinct scores across every lead in every org; and the campaign email and SMS senders read four content fields that are not columns of `campaigns`, so every recipient of every campaign received the campaign's INTERNAL NAME as the message body while `campaigns.content` went unread. Augmenting a browser/Node global (window.webkitSpeechRecognition, globalThis caches, injected window.__ENV__) is excluded BY RULE, not parked in the baseline, so this number means one thing: a domain object asked for a field it does not have. THE CHEAPEST FIX IS TO READ THE REAL FIELD, or delete the read. Widening a type to make a ghost legal is worse than the defect — it documents `undefined` as the contract.
minimaNote: VACUITY FLOORS, not ratchets. The baseline counts BAD THINGS FOUND, so a program that stops loading files finds zero and reports a reassuring PASS. Seeded 2026-08-23 at roughly 70% of live (644 casts in scope, 408 judged after excluding ambient globals and shapeless bases) so a broken tsconfig, scope regex or AST walk trips them while genuine cleanup does not. If a real deletion wave takes a population under its floor, lower the floor in the same commit and name the wave.
lastBumpNote: Seeded 2026-08-23 at the measured live count of 100. Two exclusions keep this number meaning one thing. AMBIENT bases (Window, globalThis, Document, Navigator) are excluded because augmenting a browser/Node global is a real idiom — the property genuinely is not in the ambient lib types and there is no row to read; that took 182 to 139. SHAPELESS bases (`object`, `{}`, anything with zero declared properties) are excluded because a type with no shape contradicts nothing — the cast is doing the job `any` would do; that took 139 to 100. What remains is exactly: a KNOWN shape asked for a field it does not have. A STARTING POSITION to be worked down, not an allowance.
